ops.title: missing-primitives wave: cc-transcript Word WIP discarded, full Phase A re-scoped
ops.body: The ~1700-line uncommitted Word/quote-removal WIP in cc-transcript's shared copy (session eb70d9af, visible 2026-07-19 ~00:50Z) was discarded uncommitted — no ref carries it (phase-a-v143 points at an origin/main ancestor; wf worktree branches empty; docs commit 7b0daec dropped the leaked Word re-export). The missing-primitives wave (captain-hook plan the-packs-are-doing-clever-lynx) therefore re-absorbed the FULL parser phase: POSIX quote removal + Word{text,raw,span} provenance + arity-aware wrapper unwrap + Command.split_options, implemented on branch arity-unwrap in worktree /tmp/cc-transcript-arity off origin/main (dcea84b, post-14.5.0), target release 15.0.0. Tasks d026e9c/ab9111e claimed by this wave; capt-hook-side promotions (conditions/globbing/fs/bootstrap) already implemented in the captain-hook shared tree awaiting review+ship.
